primary_outcome.name: TWSA recovery within 24 months after relief_t0

observed_twsa.monthly_value: median of available nonmissing center observations

predictor_boundary.state_baseline: median observed TWSA in 24 calendar months before meteorological drought onset; >=6 observations
predictor_boundary.state_current: latest observed TWSA <= relief_t0 and no more than 3 months old
predictor_boundary.trend: OLS slope of last 6 observed TWSA values in trailing 12 months; >=4 observations
predictor_boundary.critical_slowing: AR(1) and variance of last 12 observed TWSA values in trailing 24 months; >=8 observations
predictor_boundary.drought: Duration, Duration_Extreme, mean p_drought, peak p_extreme over the severe-drought event

holdout_rule: 2019-01 through 2022-12 labels remain unopened until final replay
